protection_domains.cybersecurity: secure boot/update design, least privilege, secret protection, tamper detection, threat modeling and audit logs
protection_domains.water_environment: rain, spray, dust, condensation, corrosion, road debris and thermal exposure; no ingress rating established
protection_domains.fire_heat_power: battery management, cell monitoring, overcurrent/overvoltage, isolation, thermal propagation and charging fault analysis
protection_domains.communications: GNSS spoofing/denial, network loss, stale commands, sensor bus failure and emergency alert loss
protection_domains.ai_data: camera/radar provenance, calibration drift, occlusion, weather degradation, uncertainty and adversarial inputs
protection_domains.mechanical: lean angle, balance, traction, wheel slip, braking, suspension, steering, crash and independent safety systems
protection_domains.human_mission: rider override, fall detection, rider protection, emergency response, privacy and stability preservation
